left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  18 years of age or older
  -  speak English
  -  be prescribed to take two or more medications  [AND] per day, and manage their own medications

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  have a significant cognitive impairment
  -  unwilling to use a novel pillbox
  -  unable to meet with the research team
